# SDDE_SelfDescribingDataExchange

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A data exchange paradigm where data packets carry self-describing metadata to enable topology-aware routing and processing within the network. Enables in-network intelligence and dynamic topology adaptation, critical for efficient TCC architectures.
